question: Does a defensible measured drug-discovery action / readout / downstream-endpoint mapping exist for testing inherited executable procedures?
method: Read data/INVENTORY.md (state and exposure columns), the closed predecessor reports and EXTERNAL_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION.json. No dataset payload, ASSETS.json body, sealed ALMANAC/PRISM tier, old G/F, unacquired C or consumed A/T background was opened; no procurement was started.

locally_present_measured_candidates.data/raw/oneil2026_qualification: present; combination screen workbooks; exposed internal development (already used by the closed studies, 18 released cells replay)
locally_present_measured_candidates.data/external/nci_almanac_2017: EMPTY_DIRECTORY_NOT_DATA; restricted ALMANAC access paths stay protected

mapping_requirements_and_status.action: measure one drug-pair unit in a background: exists for O'Neil-type complete pools (action = lookup of a pre-measured pair)
mapping_requirements_and_status.readout: a synergy/response score on a common pool: exists, one dose/endpoint definition per source
mapping_requirements_and_status.downstream_endpoint: a validated hit, follow-up result or decision payoff for the nominated pairs: NOT AVAILABLE. The closed studies scored the mean measured activity of nominated pairs, which is an internal development proxy, not a drug-discovery outcome
mapping_requirements_and_status.repeated_latent_regimes: NOT AVAILABLE as labelled structure: regime/mechanism labels are not recorded and may not be invented; the 18 released O'Neil cells cannot support learning, validating and later reusing a library of regimes
mapping_requirements_and_status.assay_cost: NOT AVAILABLE: no per-read cost, lineage cost or wet-lab sample size is recorded; none is invented here
mapping_requirements_and_status.unexposed_evaluation_backgrounds: NONE: every present measured candidate is exposed internal development; old G/F, unacquired C, consumed A/T and sealed ALMANAC/PRISM tiers are explicitly off limits

decision: NO defensible measured mapping exists. This study is SYNTHETIC METHODOLOGY DEVELOPMENT. Drug-discovery effectiveness is NOT_TESTED. No dataset procurement was initiated.
what_a_future_measured_test_would_need: only the observation structure, not a purchase: a common action pool measured in full on many independent backgrounds with replicate reads, recorded regime-relevant covariates that are not invented, an explicit read-cost model and a downstream endpoint, with history and evaluation separated before any decision is scored. Sample size is undetermined until a measured between-background standard deviation exists.
